test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person goes from J to K at a speed of 55 km/hr. He comes back from K to J at a certain speed. If his average speed is 660/17 km/hr, then what was his speed while moving from K towards J?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed from J to K (V1) = 55 km/hr

Average speed (Vavg) = 660/17 km/hr

Formula: The formula for average speed of two movements is 2V1V2/(V1 +V2)

**Solution:**

Average Speed = 2V1V2 / (V1 +V2)

**Calculation:**

Average speed = 2V1V2/(V1 +V2)

660/17 = 2 × 55 × V2)/(55 + V2)

6( 55 +V2) = 17V2 

V2 = 30 km/hr

**Therefore, the speed while moving from K towards J is 30 km/hr.**
